# The step shapes make_patch.py writes for the s35 batteries, checked by
# FileMaker's own export: the generated file is saved as XML again
# (FMDeveloperTool --saveAsXML of $WORK/s35-shapes.tasks-en.gen.fmp12) and
# each step's parameters compared with what was written. Nothing runs.
# Base file: tasks-en (generated) with the s35 schema directives.
@layout	Attachment List	Attachments	Assignments
@name	Task Details	portal:Attachments	Attachments Portal
@name	Task Details	Attachments::Description	att desc
@validate	Attachments::Description	Always	Length ( Self ) <= 3
@relationship	Attachments	Tasks	cascadeCreate=False	cascadeDelete=True
@portal	Task Details	Attachments	273
@filetrigger	OnWindowTransaction	shapes	Description

== shapes
Go to Portal Row [ First ]
Go to Portal Row [ Last ; Select: On ]
Go to Portal Row [ Previous ; Exit after last: On ]
Go to Portal Row [ Next ; Exit after last: On ]
Go to Portal Row [ Next ]
Go to Portal Row [ By calculation: 2 ; Select: On ; With dialog: Off ]
Go to Object [ Object Name: "att desc" ; Repetition: 2 ]
Go to Object [ "Assignee Portal" ]
Go to Field [ Select/perform ; Attachments::Description ]
Go to Field [ Attachments::Description[2] ]
Go to Related Record [ Show only related records: On ; From table: "Attachments" ; Using layout: "Attachment List" ]
Go to Related Record [ From table: "Attachments" ; Using layout: "Attachment List" ]
New Window [ Name: "W2" ; Layout: "Task List" ]
New Window [ ]
New Window [ Name: "W3" ; Height: 400 ; Width: 600 ; Top: 10 ; Left: 20 ]
Select Window [ Name: "W2" ; Current file ]
Select Window [ Name: "W2" ]
Select Window [ Current Window ]
Close Window [ Name: "W2" ; Current file ]
Close Window [ Current Window ]
Enter Find Mode [ Pause: Off ]
Perform Find
Revert Record/Request [ With dialog: Off ]
Delete Portal Row [ With dialog: Off ]
Delete Portal Row [ With dialog: On ]
Set Field By Name [ "Attachments::Description" ; "by name" ]
--- run
